text:
This solution, North Island Drought Financial Assistance (DEV-20-MIN-0038), 
Financial assistance relating to the North Island drought (DEV-20-SUB-0038) addresses natural catastrophe in New Zealand between New Zealand Government, Minister of Local Government, Minister of Civil Defence, Cabinet Economic Development Committee (DEV), and OECD. The program was implemented in 2020 and focuses on collaboration and raising awareness.
